title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: CAL'S SQUARE DANCE
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Cal Booker, a cell tower repairman in Knoxville, Tennessee.
Cal climbs three hundred feet and never blinks.
But on a dance floor? He freezes like a deer.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE KNOCK
segments.quote: Nobody grows old merely by a number of years. We grow old by deserting our ideals.
segments.author: Samuel Ullman
lines: Cal was forty-four, and asleep in his recliner by eight every night.
One night his neighbor Mavis knocked. She's eighty, and her dance partner just moved to Florida.
Cal said, I'm too old. Mavis laughed and quoted the writer Samuel Ullman:
Nobody grows old merely by a number of years. We grow old by deserting our ideals.
So Thursday night, Cal put on his one good shirt.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: EIGHTY CALLS
segments.quote: Begin at the beginning, and go on till you come to the end: then stop.
segments.author: Lewis Carroll
lines: The VFW hall had a fiddle, a caller, and eighty different moves.
Do-si-do. Allemande left. Cal panicked and bumped into a retired dentist.
Mavis whispered a line from Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland:
Begin at the beginning, and go on till you come to the end: then stop.
So he learned one move. Then the next. He finished, sweating.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE MOP
segments.quote: In most things success depends on knowing how long it takes to succeed.
segments.author: Montesquieu
lines: Three weeks later, he was still turning the wrong way.
Cal wanted to quit. Mavis quoted the French thinker Montesquieu:
In most things success depends on knowing how long it takes to succeed.
It took me a whole year, she said.
So Cal gave himself a year, and practiced every night with a mop.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: THE CREW
segments.quote: Do not fear to be eccentric in opinion, for every opinion now accepted was once eccentric.
segments.author: Bertrand Russell
lines: Then his tower crew found out. They hummed fiddle music all day.
Cal's ears turned red. Mavis quoted the British thinker Bertrand Russell:
Do not fear to be eccentric in opinion, for every opinion now accepted was once eccentric.
So Cal invited the whole crew.
Two of them came. One now owns a pair of boots with sparkles.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: THE JAMBOREE
segments.author: Alexandre Dumas
lines: In the spring came the big Knoxville jamboree.
Cal's first square went perfect. The caller tipped his hat.
Mavis grinned and quoted the French novelist Alexandre Dumas:
Nothing succeeds like success.
So Cal stopped watching his feet, and danced every square until midnight.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE TOAST
segments.quote: May you live all the days of your life.
segments.author: Jonathan Swift
lines: On Mavis's eighty-first birthday, the whole hall brought cake.
Cal raised his paper cup and quoted the Irish writer Jonathan Swift:
May you live all the days of your life.
Mavis said, I am. And so are you, finally.
Now Cal teaches the new folks. He starts with one move.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Stay young. Start small. Give it time. Be different. Enjoy the wins. Live every day.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Stay young inside. Start with one step. Give it time. Be different. Enjoy a win. And live every day.
I tried square dancing once. The caller said swing your partner. I swung so hard I lost a shoe.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
